description: Exact new diagnostic-order rows extracted from the completed successful regression/benchmark job. Other named workloads remain in the original full report. This file does not certify the status of the separate browser job or overall workflow.
methodology: Ten identical ordering requests over 10,000 preprojected immutable diagnostic rows per sample. fresh_stable_sort constructs a fresh query view and stable ordering for each request; cached_order_lookup returns an existing array from one warm view. These are two modes of the SAME new implementation, not a prior implementation, vendor comparison or faster fresh sort. Snapshot/projection construction and initial cached ordering are excluded. Stopwatch timings and current-thread managed allocations only. Native memory, other threads, UI binding, layout, input latency, painting and physical-GPU performance are not measured.

otherResultsNotHidden.note: The pre-existing model-only compiler regression and worse semantic-warm tail latency remain in the complete report; this diagnostic cache increment does not resolve them or imply uniform editor/compiler speedups.
